name: U05 - Grafting a List
context:
3- Grafting a List:

- "Grafting" a List makes each of the items a Branch!

- So in a way, it does the opposite of what "Flatenning" does.

- Type "Graft" and graft the flatenned tree.

- Notice that as there used to be 10 items inside the flatenned List, after grafting the List, there are now 10 Branches inside this new Tree!

- There is also the "Unflatten Tree" which unflattens a Tree using a path guide. This component is not often used.
